physical_filament: Black PET-GF, left external spool 254; PET-CF printer metadata
user_statement: If we are going to add zip ties to the Beduans for retention, then this print is perfect. Perfectly fits in easily, and is held somewhat even upside down loose shaking.
insertion: Easy, described as a perfect fit with zip-tie retention.
inverted_retention: Some retention during loose shaking; no measured retention force.
positive_retention: Zip ties through the production retention paths; socket friction is not the retention mechanism.
design_action: Preserve the physically accepted socket profile. Verify access to thread and tighten the ties in the complete carrier and enclosure.
scope: Socket coupon fit only; full carrier stiffness, installed tie access, tube operation and complete enclosure release remain separate checks.
